research.name: q5.js
research.note: Creative coding library with a p5.js-style API that draws 2D sketches through a WebGPU renderer and custom WGSL shaders.

effects: p5.js-compatible sketch API rendered through WebGPU
MSDF text rendering in a WGSL text shader
user-replaceable shape, image, text, frame and video shaders (createShapesShader and siblings)
top-level await Canvas() sketch format without preload or setup
homepage hero sketch of draggable noise-deformed lava blobs

unverified: The only visual seen was one frame (the YouTube thumbnail) of the project's v4.0 release video, showing warped and motion-blurred numeral 4 glyphs on a light blue background; that this frame was rendered with q5 is inferred from it being the project's release video.

q5js.org and q5js.org/learn are rendered client side and returned no content to WebFetch, so the live homepage sketch and interactive docs examples were not seen running; the signature effects are taken from the repository source and homepage HTML, not from watching them.
The homepage claims of SDF shape rendering, HDR colors by default and being 100x faster than p5.js were read as claims only and not confirmed.
